definitions.explanation: Without any delay, at this very moment. Emphasizes urgency or the desire for immediate action.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}すぐ⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{今|いま}すぐ⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

{今|いま}すぐ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: You don't need to give an answer right away, so please take your time to think.

notes:
A combination of ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ (now) and ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ (immediately). Stronger and more urgent than ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ alone. Very common in both spoken and written Japanese, used in requests, commands, and statements about immediate action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今|いま}すぐ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go right now
- {今|いま}すぐ⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧: to want it right now
- {今|いま}すぐ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even right this moment
- {今|いま}すぐ{始|はじ}める: to start immediately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧: immediately, soon — less emphatic, can also mean "soon" rather than "this instant"
- ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧: immediately — formal and often used in official contexts or announcements
- ⟦{早急|さっきゅう}→早急：18512_sakkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: urgently — formal, emphasizes the need for speed rather than the present moment
